evidence: Cic. Phil. 11.28: quā lēge, quō jūre? (not checked)
Cic. Verr. 2.5.151: quis tibi id permīsit? quō jūre fēcistī? (not checked)
terms.comment: Cicero’s challenge to an act done without authority, beside quā lēge, “under what law?”.
